title: What Matters in Quality-Aware VLA Pretraining: A Benchmark and Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.18869v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How should demonstration quality be used during vision-language-action (VLA) pretraining to improve performance after target-task fine-tuning? We compare weighting, filtering, and conditioning across reward definitions and label granularities using 5,000 naturally suboptimal human demonstrations and 24 target tasks. Within each VLA, we match demonstrations and training budgets. Additional comparisons examine pretraining data size and the roles of quality tags during fine-tuning and inference. Across three VLAs, we find that approach-aware episode conditioning improves mean success over plain behavioral cloning; conditioning and filtering favor episode and chunk labels, respectively, on average, with model-dependent reversals; and constant-tag fine-tuning improves mean success after conditioned pretraining with either tagged or untagged inference. We introduce AXIS-Bench to support these controlled comparisons. Built on crowdsourced sim

translated_title: 质量感知VLA预训练中的关键因素：基准与实证研究
translated_abstract: 在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）预训练中，应如何利用演示质量来提升目标任务微调后的性能？我们使用5,000条天然次优的人类演示和24个目标任务，比较了加权、过滤和条件化这三种方式在不同奖励定义和标签粒度下的表现。在每个VLA模型内部，我们保持了演示数据和训练预算的一致。额外的比较还考察了预训练数据规模，以及质量标签在微调和推理阶段所起的作用。在三个VLA模型上的实验发现：感知方法的轨迹级条件化相比普通行为克隆能提升平均成功率；平均而言，条件化更偏好轨迹级标签，而过滤更偏好分块级标签，但存在因模型而异的反转现象；在采用条件化预训练后，使用恒定标签进行微调，无论推理时是否使用标签，都能提高平均成功率。我们引入了AXIS-Bench以支持这些受控比较。该基准基于众包仿真环境构建
tldr: 该论文提出了AXIS-Bench基准，通过受控实证研究系统比较了VLA预训练中利用演示质量的不同方式，发现感知方法的轨迹级条件化预训练相比普通行为克隆能显著提升下游任务微调后的成功率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AXIS-Bench and conducts a controlled empirical study comparing ways to leverage demonstration quality in VLA pretraining, finding that approach-aware episode-level conditioning outperforms plain behavioral cloning in improving post-fine-tuning task success.
